items.title: Meta Ads: $349.74 spend, 26 leads, $13.45 CPL (2026-08-16 to 2026-08-22)
items.summary: Widened window (last successful run was 2026-08-14, covering 2026-08-13) — reporting the 7 most recent full days, 2026-08-16 through 2026-08-22. Meta spent $349.74, all on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 26 leads at $13.45 CPL — below the prior 7-day baseline (2026-08-09 to 2026-08-15) of $15.21 CPL. Account is ACTIVE, currency CAD, no ads flagged.

needs_attention: Coverage gap: the last successful meta-ads.json run was 2026-08-14 (covering yesterday=2026-08-13). This run widened --days to 7 (the cap) to cover the gap, giving 2026-08-16 through 2026-08-22 — but 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-15 fall outside even the widened window and were never pulled, so spend/leads for those two days are permanently missing from meta-ads ingest history. Recommend running ingest daily going forward to avoid recurring gaps.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 26 in this window, 23 in the prior 7-day baseline), matching the counted `leads` figure exactly both times, same pattern noted in the 2026-08-14 run. No discrepancy today, but this should be reviewed for whether the script's LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set needs extending, not hand-patched here.
